purpose: Blinded-label validation of evaluator-v1 on the 14 failed campaign runs (EVALUATOR_SPEC §6).

labels.protocol_deviation: results/protocol-deviations.json#1 (model rater labeled instead of the owner; blinding protocol unchanged)
labels.blinded: 14/14 initial labels blinded (recorded before any evaluator output was opened or disclosed; reveal markers written afterwards under results/reviews/<run>/reveal.json)
labels.inputs: task instruction + full raw trajectory + frozen rubric-v1 + termination note; outcome knowledge limited to 'this run failed'
labels.asymmetry_note: The rater knew the run failed; the judge is outcome-blinded by design. Outcome knowledge can bias a rater toward finding violations, so the verdict-agreement number below overstates the gap by an unknown but non-zero margin. It cannot explain the localization gap: 12 rater first-error steps carry step-anchored rationales that cite specific contradicting observations.

localization_merged_vs_reference.definitions: exact/±1 over all 14 labeled failed runs, counting both-sides-'none' as agreement (2 such runs) — the located-only row restricts to the 12 runs whose reference label locates a step
localization_merged_vs_reference.correction_note: the first cut of this record reported 1/14 by silently dropping the two none-none agreements while its own exclusions note claimed they counted; definitions made explicit and numbers recomputed at the v2 regression review (the exporter and the regression card now share these definitions)

three_way_localization.replay_none_interpretation: replay 'none' asserts only that no prefix flips oracle-reachability (no causally destructive step); on 11 of those 13 runs the reference label locates a reasoning/interpretation/verification step that leaves the task completable, so 'none' is consistent but uninformative for those error classes

false_positive_rate.note: honest null: the evaluator flagged 0 resolved runs process-invalid, so the FP audit has an empty denominator; given the detection numbers below, the near-zero flag rate reflects leniency, not precision

discriminative_fixtures.detail: valid fixture -> valid/none; invalid fixture -> invalid @ step 4, action_execution; inconclusive fixture -> judge skipped

consistency.pm1_note: first_error_pm1 reads 0/40 only because no pair had BOTH sessions locate a step (official localizations are 'none' everywhere except none-vs-12 on the flagged run); comparable pairs = 0, so the ±1 row is an honest empty denominator, not a disagreement
consistency.schemelike_note: hy3-terminus-2__schemelike-metacircular-eval counts as non-agreeing because both sessions are status context_limit (both_ok=false); behaviorally the repeat reproduced the same honest refusal
consistency.boundary_case: the single genuine verdict disagreement is the flagged run itself: the repeat session returned partial with a non-recovered reasoning finding at step 12 — the same step replay flipped on and the reference label chose — while the official session and all 5 stability sessions said valid; 1 of 7 total judge sessions on this run crossed the detection threshold, so the leniency failure mode is systematic with rare borderline crossings, not sampling noise
consistency.spend_estimate: 44 judge API calls (39 repeats + 5 stability; the context_limit run consumes no call), ≈1.2M tokens at the measured ~28K/call; gateway console is authoritative
consistency.interpretation: temperature-0 self-consistency is excellent (38/39 among completed pairs; 5/5 on the flagged run), so the Day 7 detection gap is a systematic rubric/prompt problem, not instrument variance — exactly the case evaluator-v2 (decision 16) is scoped to address

evaluator_v1_failure_modes.evidence: judge verdicts: 39/39 completed official calls returned 'valid' (25 resolved + 14 failed); 37/40 returned zero findings; the blinded reference labels rate 12/14 failed runs partial or invalid with step-anchored rationales; across 44 repeat/stability sessions exactly one crossed the threshold (partial @ step 12 on the flagged run, matching replay and the reference label), confirming the leniency is systematic rather than noise
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.diagnosis: rubric-v1 detects blatant destructive/integrity violations (fixture gate passes; stability 5/5 on the doctored fixture) but does not surface subtle reasoning, interpretation, and verification failures in long real trajectories; head+tail observation truncation likely removes part of the contradicting evidence the rater used
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.drives_v2: semantic lane: rubric/prompt revision (mandatory audits before the verdict, valid-as-earned-not-default semantics, quoted-evidence rationales) plus a wider fixed observation-truncation window (the v1 head+tail of 1600+800 chars plausibly removed decisive evidence the rater used; the failed-run bundles fit far larger windows within the gateway limit), re-run over stored bundles under the decision-16 regression card

evaluator_v1_failure_modes.status: WITHDRAWN after code re-inspection at v2 design review — recorded here rather than deleted
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.correction: merge_lanes already prefers a judge-located step whenever replay does not locate (the replay branch only takes precedence on localization='located'); the 13/14 merged 'none' locations trace entirely to the judge's own 'none', i.e. to the leniency mode above, not to a merge-policy defect. The original entry misread the precedence branch.
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.residual_v2_item: when replay DOES locate and the judge contradicts it with 'valid', v1 keeps the semantic 'valid' (only flagging); v2 caps the process verdict at 'partial' on a causal flip, mirroring the hard-failure precedence — matching the one measured case (the flagged run, reference label partial @ the replay step)

evaluator_v1_failure_modes.evidence: hy3-terminus-2__financial-document-processor: merged first_error located at step 12 (replay) but primary_error_type is null because replay carries no category and the judge returned valid
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.diagnosis: category attribution has no fallback when localization comes from replay alone
evaluator_v1_failure_modes.drives_v2: merge policy: category fallback (deterministic facts at the step, else 'action_execution' for a causally destructive flip) or an explicit 'uncategorized' export

flagged_for_human_adjudication.reason: lane conflict: replay located step 12 (causal flip) while the judge returned valid; reference label agrees with replay (step 12); owner to adjudicate the process label and category
resolved with no semantic verdict (judge context_limit on a prompt beyond the gateway input limit); owner to confirm the honest-null handling
